LESSON: ENGAGING PARENTS OR

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Care for the 3.3.2Communicating messages By the end of the sub-strand, the  Lea
Topic 3.3.3: Engaging parents or

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Engaging parents or. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify ways of involving management
2. involve parents or guardians in waste management
3. appreciate the participation of parents or guardians in waste management guardians in establishing simple waste management projects.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify ways of involving management
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify ways of involving management. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. involve parents or guardians in waste management
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to involve parents or guardians in waste management. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate the participation of parents or guardians in waste management guardians in establishing simple waste management projects.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the participation of parents or guardians in waste management guardians in establishing simple waste management projects. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Engaging parents or.
2. Explain Engaging parents or to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Engaging parents or.
4. Show that you can: identify ways of involving management
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Engaging parents or. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Engaging parents or important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify ways of involving management
2. involve parents or guardians in waste management
3. appreciate the participation of parents or guardians in waste management guardians in establishing simple waste management projects.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
